title: Grade 8 Mathematics - Rational Numbers and Exponents
description: A CBSE and CISCE-aligned Grade 8 Mathematics course covering Rational Numbers and Exponents. It follows CBSE/NCERT middle-stage Mathematics and CISCE Upper Primary Mathematics with clear theory, visuals, solved examples and practice.
subject: Mathematics

chapters.name: Rational Numbers
learningObjectives: Understand and solve syllabus-aligned problems on Closure and properties
Understand and solve syllabus-aligned problems on Rational numbers between two numbers
Understand and solve syllabus-aligned problems on Operations with rational numbers
Understand and solve syllabus-aligned problems on Representation on number line

chapters.name: Exponents and Standard Form
learningObjectives: Understand and solve syllabus-aligned problems on Laws of exponents
Understand and solve syllabus-aligned problems on Negative exponents introduction
Understand and solve syllabus-aligned problems on Standard form
Understand and solve syllabus-aligned problems on Large and small numbers

learningOutcomes: Explain the key CBSE and CISCE ideas in Rational Numbers and Exponents
Use diagrams, tables, equations or graphs to model problems
Solve graded practice and board-style questions
Apply the concepts in real-life situations
